info.title: CRM Channel API
info.description:
Experience API that fronts internal CRM microservices (contact-information-xp, mm-otp-xp, customer-score-svc) behind a single, typed, consistently-enveloped contract.

## Authentication

The API is fronted by the external gateway, which requires an OAuth2 access
token obtained with the **client credentials** flow from AWS Cognito.
Credentials are issued per consumer — request them from the platform team.

```sh
curl -X POST https://mm-dev-auth.auth.us-west-1.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "grant_type=client_credentials" \
  -d "client_id=<CLIENT_ID>" \
  -d "client_secret=<CLIENT_SECRET>" \
  -d "scope=https://api.dev.multimoney.tech/read"
```

Send the returned `access_token` on every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

Tokens expire (`expires_in`, seconds); request a new one when they do.

post.description: Side effects: sends a real SMS/email/WhatsApp message (per-send cost). Passing `otp` triggers the upstream resend flow. Rate limited per user_id.

sessionId.title: Sessionid
sessionId.description: Session start time in milliseconds since epoch.

DataEnvelope.title: DataEnvelope
DataEnvelope.description:
contact-information-xp wraps all success bodies as {"data": ...}.

Entity shapes are DB-backed and numerous; the gateway forwards them
verbatim inside this envelope.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description: A single field-level error, when the upstream provides one.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Required when channel is sms or whatsapp (e.g. +521234567890).

otp.title: Otp
otp.description: Encrypted OTP in 'hex:hex:hex' format; presence triggers the resend flow.

type.title: Type
type.description: URI identifying the problem type (urn:problem:crm-channel-api:* for gateway-originated problems; upstream URNs pass through).

title.title: Title
title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.title: Status
status.description: HTTP status code returned by the gateway.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.title: Instance
instance.description: Request path that produced this occurrence.

upstream_status.title: Upstream Status
upstream_status.description: Extension: original status code from the upstream service.

ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail
ProblemDetail.description:
RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs.

All upstream error conventions ({error}, {success:false,...}, and native
problem+json) are normalized into this shape. `errors` and `upstream_status`
are extension members (RFC 9457 §3.2).

UtmInput.title: UtmInput
UtmInput.description: At least one UTM field is required by the upstream.
